notes: The week of training has an overnight stay at the Dana Brown Overnight Center. Only full applications are looked at.
name: SIFT: Shaw Institute for Field Training
org: Tyson Research Center and Shaw Nature Reserve (Missouri Botanical Garden)
what_you_do: An 11 month program for teens. It starts with a week of summer field training. Then come paid field programs such as controlled fire, bird banding, fungus surveys, habitat repair and data collection.
who_can_apply: Current 9th and 10th graders from the St. Louis region (they join as rising 10th and 11th graders). A cohort of 20. Needs two teacher recommendations.
pay_detail: Stipend based on the number of hours you work at SIFT events. Amount not stated.
duration: 11 months (training week in early June, then field programs through April)
deadline_text: Page pattern: application available in December, due in February, notification in March. The page described the Summer 2026 cycle.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form from December to February. Send 2 teacher recommendations. Give clear answers to every question.
